images.caption: Figure 1:EmoHarnessat a glance.(a)A selected held-out clip (Gemma-4-E4B; Figure4a): posture suggestsneutral, the wordsnegative. Video, Audio (video plus transcript and prosody text), and Shared (the human-written scaffold) miss the reference; both MHE harnesses answernegative.(b)Offline, a Builder LLM (GPT-5.6 Luna or GPT-6.1 Sol) edits the harness from the frozen student’s failures and execution traces; checks and validation gates promote edits over four generations.(c)Task-macro Recognition contrasts (VL: Qwen3-VL; Q3.5: Qwen3.5-4B).

Figure 2:How Meta-Harness Evolving builds a harness and how the frozen student runs it.(a)Offline, the Builder turns the incumbent’s construction failures and traces into at most four candidate edits per generation; static checks, a proposal reviewer, and the gates of Eq.3promote the best candidate or retain the incumbent, and after four generations the harness is frozen.(b)At inference the frozen student makes four calls (at most six with retries) around deterministic verification and a fixed controller. The example is the fine-grained sentiment (FG-SA) clip of Appendix Figure11a: the evidence and the quoted output come from the GPT-5.6 Luna harness on Qwen3-VL-4B; the Propose rows, the confusions in (a), and c1–c4 are illustrative.

Figure 4:Case study: MHE versus baselines on Gemma-4-E4B.The input is drawn once: instruction, transcript, and five of our seven sampled frames per clip (the student saw 2 fps), subtitled with the words spoken within 0.12 s of each frame (every condition except Video receives the transcript); lettered boxes mark the regions that cards cite. Each card gives one condition’s answer (green: correct; red: wrong), and the tags between cards name what each condition adds. Note glyphs: green check (supported); red cross (misread, unsupported, or wrong); amber note (audio-derived); gray dash (limitation). The last MHE note gives the answer of the GPT-6.1 Sol harness; [vii]/[ajj]: evidence IDs. The edit panel quotes the rule GPT-5.6 Luna added to the review prompt, with verbatim Shared and MHE excerpts. Cases are selected, not representative.

Figure 11:Additional cases.Selected, not representative; letters, note glyphs, and subtitles as in Figure4(no headline tags or edit panels); merged cards report two conditions that agree.(a)Qwen3-VL-4B, FG-SA: the GPT-5.6 Luna harness reaches the referencenegative; GPT-6.1 Sol’s does not.(b)Qwen3-VL-8B, ER-Lab: the correctExcitedfits the evolved ranking code, while the written explanation favorsHappiness.
